mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of central bank rate cuts and triggers a flight to equity risk premia, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, which triggers a policy response from the Federal Reserve and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered cases, or the interaction term has a negative or insignificant coefficient in a multivariate regression (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the likelihood of monetary stimulus and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL above 213.0 within one month signals rising inflationary pressure, which triggers a forward-looking expectation of tighter monetary policy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 9.0% and a decline in payroll employment below 132,000 signals a labor market breakdown, which increases the probability of aggressive Fed intervention and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 335,000 million dollars combined with a drop in housing starts below 450 thousand units signals a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a policy response and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a negative or insignificant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 for two consecutive months, combined with a stagnating GDP growth rate (GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized), indicates a weakening real economy, which increases the likelihood of fiscal or monetary stimulus and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 months and GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.
